# opnsense_ntp_settings (Resource)

Manages the built-in OPNsense NTP service through `os-api-extensions`. This is a singleton resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_ntp_settings.main
  id = "ntp_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_ntp_settings" "main" {
  enabled    = true
  interfaces = ["opt1"]
  orphan     = 12
  max_clock  = 10

  servers = [
    {
      host     = "0.pool.ntp.org"
      pool     = true
      iburst   = true
      prefer   = true
      noselect = false
    }
  ]

  kiss_of_death          = true
  rate_limiting          = true
  deny_modifications     = true
  disable_queries        = true
  deny_peer_associations = true
  deny_trap_service      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interfaces` (Set of String) Logical OPNsense interfaces on which NTP listens and sends queries. An explicit non-empty set prevents wildcard listeners.
- `servers` (Attributes Set) Upstream NTP servers. At least one server is always required so re-enabling cannot create an unconfigured service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

### Optional

- `client_mode` (Boolean) Synchronize once and exit instead of serving NTP. Defaults to `false`.
- `deny_modifications` (Boolean) Deny runtime state modifications from remote clients. Defaults to `true`.
- `deny_peer_associations` (Boolean) Deny remote peer association attempts. Defaults to `true`.
- `deny_trap_service` (Boolean) Deny mode 6 trap service. Defaults to `true`.
- `disable_queries` (Boolean) Disable remote ntpq and ntpdc queries. Defaults to `true`.
- `disable_serving` (Boolean) Disable time service while retaining query access. Defaults to `false`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable NTP synchronization and serving. Defaults to `true`.
- `kiss_of_death` (Boolean) Enable Kiss-o'-Death packets. Defaults to `true`.
- `max_clock` (Number) Maximum retained clock associations. Defaults to `10`.
- `orphan` (Number) Orphan mode stratum. Defaults to `12`.
- `rate_limiting` (Boolean) Enable NTP rate limiting. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier `ntp_settings`.

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Required:

- `host` (String) NTP server hostname or IP address.

Optional:

- `iburst` (Boolean) Use an initial burst of requests for faster synchronization.
- `noselect` (Boolean) Collect statistics but never select this source.
- `pool` (Boolean) Treat the hostname as an NTP pool.
- `prefer` (Boolean) Prefer this source when candidates are otherwise equivalent.
